description: This file defines the AzureVideoConfig class for configuring OpenAI video generation within an Azure environment, including parameter support, environment validation, and URL construction.

classes.name: AzureVideoConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI video generation on Azure, supporting parameter listing, environment validation, and URL formation.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for video generation.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Returns the input parameters as-is, assuming they are already in OpenAI format.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates Azure environment and sets up authentication headers, handling credentials via litellm_params.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs and returns the complete API URL for video requests.
